usr_d99d91af-04e.title: OpenCode MCP Setup
usr_d99d91af-04e.content:
# OpenCode MCP Integration

Connect **OpenCode** directly to your self-hosted Docker note server so your coding agent can read specifications, architecture diagrams, and project notes without manual copy-paste.

## Exposed MCP Tools

| Tool | Purpose | Auth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list_notes` | List all MCP-enabled notes and folder paths | Bearer Token |
| `read_note` | Read full Markdown and concept diagram labels | Bearer Token |
| `search_notes` | Search notes by keyword or `#tag` | Bearer Token |
| `create_note` | Save coding findings back into your vault | Bearer Token |

Open the **OpenCode MCP** button in the top bar to mint a scoped token and copy your `opencode.json` snippet.
